message: Your plan is stronger on layout pruning, drop hit-testing, and attachment ownership. I concede those points and choose opus as implementer. I cannot accept the `chat_titles` overlay: task.md explicitly requires pi `set_session_name`, and the local pi reference says that command writes the session’s display name. For an inactive chat, switch to it, await the switch, rename it, and refresh the chat list. Fix `agent.rs::read_chat` so a `session_info` entry after `CHAT_HEAD` is visible instead of creating a second title store. I accept the rest of your plan.
plan: Use opus’s plan for all nine findings, with chat rename changed to pi `set_session_name` and `read_chat` updated to find late session names. Keep the no-follow chat deletion checks, canonical drop confirmation, loaded-only layout pruning, stable map nodes, attachment tokens, and mounted settings draft.
conceded: Opus’s loaded-only layout pruning and stable node merge
Opus’s boundary drop hit-testing and canonical path confirmation
Opus’s attachment token and detach design
